sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-38b"
sources.quote: K2-38b, also designated EPIC 204221263 b, is a massive rocky exoplanet closely orbiting a Sun-like star and is one of the densest planets ever found.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Toledo-Padrón et al. 2020.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-38b"
sources.quote: Discovered in 2016 by Crossfield et al. and later characterized by Sinukoff et al., K2-38b is a rocky super-Earth about 55% larger than Earth but about 12 times more massive indicating a composition rich in iron and an extremely high surface gravity.
